subject: POC kickoff summary + low-effort checklist
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Tom Fischer <tom.fischer@greenwave.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff summary + low-effort checklist

Hi Tom — thanks again for a productive discovery call this morning. Quick recap and a tiny checklist so the POC can get useful signals without blocking your team: 

Summary from call:
- Goal: validate latency and cost for our customer-facing recommendation pipeline (100-300 tokens per request, 50 qps burst)
- Success metric: 95th perc latency < 120ms and cost per 1M tokens <= target we discussed
- Timeline: want demonstrable results in a 2-week window

Low-effort checklist (should take <1 hour for an engineer):
1) Access: confirm you can open the trial project we provisioned (link + creds in attached redwood-trial-access-instructions.txt)
2) SDK import: add redwood SDK to the service and run the minimal smoke example in POC-checklist.xlsx -> step 1
3) Sample payload: run 100 requests locally with the sample payload (included) and send us the 95th latency numbers

If you want, we can run a 30-minute hands-on session to complete steps 1–3 and capture metrics; open slots below this week and next: Tue/Wed 10–11am PT or Thu 2–3pm PT.

Attachments: POC-checklist.xlsx (checklist + sample payload), redwood-trial-access-instructions.txt

Thanks — I’ll stand by while your infra lead gives a thumbs up.

Best,
Soojin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
(415) 555-0132

---
On the call were: Tom (GreenWave), Soojin (Redwood), Marissa (Redwood - CS)
From: Tom Fischer <tom.fischer@greenwave.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff summary + low-effort checklist

Appreciate the summary, Soojin. I'll loop in our infra lead and try the checklist early next week. Might need that hands-on session — could you tentatively hold Tue 10am PT? Will confirm by Monday.

Best,
Tom
Head of Platform Engineering, GreenWave Analytics

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Tom Fischer <tom.fischer@greenwave.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff summary + low-effort checklist

Thanks, Tom — holding Tue 10am PT tentatively. Quick note: if your infra lead is tight on time we can do a pared-down session that only covers access + running the smoke script (20–25 min).

Also adding the short runbook in this thread so it's easy to follow: 
- Step A: copy creds from redwood-trial-access-instructions.txt into env vars
- Step B: pip install redwood-client && run smoke.py
- Step C: paste the 95th latency from smoke output back to this thread

If I don't hear back by Wednesday end of day, I'll follow up with a single check-in.

Cheers,
Soojin
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Tom Fischer <tom.fischer@greenwave.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: quick check — priority on the GreenWave POC?

Hi Tom — just checking in since I haven't seen the smoke results. Is the POC still a priority for GreenWave this quarter? 

If the team is tight, two low-friction options to keep momentum: 
- We run the smoke test from our side using a small synthetic payload and share the numbers (no access needed)
- Or we pause and reconvene in a few weeks — I can put a short summary together for when you’re ready.

Which would you prefer? If helpful I can also have Marissa hop on for a quick pairing session to unblock any infra gotchas.

Thanks — Soojin
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Fischer <tom.fischer@greenwave.io>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2026 09:01:00 -0700
Subject: Can I help with the environment build?

Hi Tom — Marissa from Customer Success here. Quick intro — I can pair with your infra engineer to get the trial project connected and run the smoke script. Typical pairing session is 20–30 minutes. Would you like me to schedule something in the next week?

If you prefer, I can also do the synthetic run and share the numbers so you have a baseline without scheduling.

—Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Tom Fischer <tom.fischer@greenwave.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff summary + low-effort checklist

Hi Soojin / Marissa — thanks for the follow-ups and for offering hands-on help. Quick update from our side: leadership pulled our reliability sprint forward, so infra is focused on that through April. We need to deprioritize the POC work for now and revisit in Q3. 

That said, a synthetic run would be useful so we have baseline numbers when we come back. If you can run that and drop a short one-page summary (95th latency, token cost estimate, any obvious integration notes), that would be perfect. No scheduling needed from our side right now.

Thanks again,
Tom
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Tom Fischer <tom.fischer@greenwave.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff summary + low-effort checklist

Totally understand, Tom — thanks for the update. We'll run the synthetic baseline and share a one-page summary by next Thu (April 2). If anything changes or if you'd like a short demo when you're ready, just ping me.

Closing the loop here.

Best,
Soojin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
